Kz.bar_b_note: A clean, warm, readable elder villager with good face and eyes and an earthy green-brown palette that fits the Meadows; the sides are near-identical and the full-body view is small but holds its silhouette.

Pt.bar_b_note: A's open grassy ridge with the watchtower and cool sky is on the right road, but the evenly spaced cartoon tree wall, the approach camera jammed against a giant chain prop and B's trunk-filled gameplay/detail views sink it.

Sm.bar_b_note: The Voltarach model matches its board, but the fight is a dim brown murk with no purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta telegraph rings, a barely visible player creature and a HUD covering much of the frame; A also has foliage filling the camera.

Zc.bar_b_note: A's afters (banner gone, freed captive, smoke plume) read as wins, but smeared low-resolution ground textures, a tiled flat stone wall at site 1 and B keeping the enemy banner standing in three afters keep it short of shipping finish.

Vy.bar_b_note: Same frames as Pt: A's open ridge with the watchtower reads as a place, but the uniform tree wall, the camera against the chain prop in the approach view and B's trunk-enclosed views sink it.

Ln.bar_b_note: The naturalistic white wolf fur with blue accents sits near the owner's Tanglevolt in-game bar and stands larger than the trainer, though A's faint end collapses into an unreadable white blob and B's faint mid floats above its shadow.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight: replace the flat magenta telegraph rings and slabs with real-object telegraphs (lightning, cracked ground), keep foliage and trunks off the camera, add the purple storm sky and white-violet rim light so both fighters separate from the ground, and slim the HUD over the action.

Ridgeline Watch: clear a readable clearing around the watchtower in every production camera, break the evenly spaced tree wall into groves and edges, and move the approach camera off the giant chain/beam prop.

Faction-site aftermaths: always remove the oxblood banners after the win, give each site its own aftermath (freed captive, smoke, toppled gear), and replace the smeared ground and tiled stone-wall textures with sharper materials.
